controls.cancellationScope: Deterministically cancelled when the unchanged core enumerates the second eligible segment; no claim of deepest-search interruption latency.

graphBudgetFailure.message: The selected tray geometry exceeds the 2 routing-node limit. Select a smaller tray area or simplify the tray geometry.

controls.note: Only negative-control graph budget is lowered. No production/default capacity ceiling is raised.

scope.graphReuse: NOT_IMPLEMENTED; unchanged core builds graph for every query
scope.memoryReuse: same PreparedModel benchmark only; production still uses one-shot ModelRunner
scope.queryReuseScope: Repeated identical endpoints/category/options within each dataset; query-order, changed-endpoint and changed-category independence are not established.
scope.timeoutScope: Cooperative phase/total cancellation only; the external orchestrator owns the hard process/container deadline.
scope.workflowCompatibility: Synthetic chains with more than100 route codes are mathematical Core capacity probes, not proof of WFC Viewer/Apply compatibility.
scope.semanticHashFormat: recursive-ordinal-key canonical .NET JSON; full baseline objects retained for independent Node canonicalization without numeric rounding
scope.memoryScope: own benchmark process only; current/lifetime peak working set and process-wide managed allocations, not per-phase isolated peak or child-tree RSS
scope.coldDefinition: Cold means no fitted disk/memory cache for that dataset. Input was already hashed, parsed and validated; process/JIT/OS caches are shared across sequential datasets.
scope.queryMeasurementScope: Unchanged Calculate plus design calculation, expected checks and full canonical semantic serialization/hash; this is not an isolated search-only timer.
scope.jitWarmup: No explicit warmup is added. Prevalidation and earlier cases can warm JIT/OS caches. Repetitions can reuse mesh-clearance proof caches; fresh production-process timings are measured separately.
